label: About
title: About Anodized Ghost Herbarium
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 320 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 3 and @artofallan: Reworking old explorations of my diesel punk/cassette futurism world from a few..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Anodized Ghost Herbarium: Anodized Ghost Herbarium: a product-photo rupture on a side-lit object slab, portrait pale aluminum mounted in warm off-white space. Sparse horizontal black dash-ports shift density into a barely-there central face pressure, not a portrait. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against full raster dash slab, upper-right dense socket knot, and lower-right black port block.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
